summary: Auth stage tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest auth tests passed (protection 401 on /siswa /absensi POST/GET /generate-absensi /me; login wrong-creds generic 401 with no cookie; unknown user same generic error; successful login sets access_token cookie and returns no Password_Hash; /me returns user without hash; protected endpoints work after login; logout clears cookie; rate limit returns 429 on 6th failed attempt for throwaway user; admin can still log in while other user locked). Frontend (Playwright): logged-out root redirects to /login; login-form + inputs + submit present; absensi-card hidden pre-login; wrong creds show generic 'Username atau password salah' via login-error and stay on /login; correct creds redirect to home showing absensi-card + logout-button; page reload preserves session (no bounce); 5 student rows render, kelas filter populated, generate & export buttons present; status-select-S001 changed to Sakit and toast 'Status Ahmad Fauzi berhasil diperbarui → Sakit' shown; logout redirects to /login and revisit / bounces back to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger declared after routes (line ~341) that reference `logger` in exception handlers — works because handlers execute later but ordering is fragile (carried over from iter1/2).
Rate-limit store `_login_fails` is in-memory only — will not persist across worker restarts or scale to multiple pods. Acceptable for single-instance MVP; document if horizontal scaling is planned.

test_absensi.py from iter1/2 now fails against protected endpoints because it does not authenticate. Recommend adding a fixture that performs POST /api/login and reuses the session so the legacy regression suite continues to pass. Not fixed here to avoid scope creep, but tracked here.
Cookie sent with secure=True + samesite=lax — correct for the shared HTTPS preview origin; note this would break local http testing (acceptable).
